issues.issue: Did the Respondent breach procedural fairness by not disclosing the last BoC amendment before the hearing?
issues.applicant_position: Minister says the Respondent breached RPD Rules and natural justice by not disclosing the last BoC amendment.
issues.respondent_position: Amendment re-signed on hearing day; not new; irrelevant to the IFA issue; Minister's concern unfounded.
issues.result_text: Breach found but immaterial: pre-flight experiences not credible and case decided on IFA.

issues.issue: Did the RPD err by questioning the Respondent's brother (witness) beyond identity?
issues.applicant_position: Minister says the witness was to testify only on identity; the Respondent breached natural justice by not notifying Minister.
issues.respondent_position: RPD may question witness beyond identity; Minister chose not to attend; no contravention of RPD Rules.
issues.result_text: RPD was not restricted to identity questions; no breach of procedural fairness.

issues.issue: Did the RPD err in its credibility assessment?
issues.applicant_position: Minister says RPD erred in its credibility analysis.
issues.respondent_position: RAD should defer to RPD credibility findings; Respondent's evidence on limited family ties is credible.
issues.result_text: Respondent consistent on identity, citizenship and clan; no significant inconsistencies found.

issues.issue: Is relocation to Mogadishu (IFA) reasonable for the Respondent?
issues.applicant_position: Minister says RPD erred by accepting lack of social support in the IFA analysis despite credibility problems.
issues.respondent_position: Residual profile in Bulo Burte; weak Mogadishu links; no protection or support; IFA unreasonable.
issues.result_text: IFA in Mogadishu unreasonable; well-founded fear under s.96 established; RPD decision confirmed.
